channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Real estate in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−2.4).

item.title: [−2] RBI may hike repo rate by 25-50 bps in December as inflation breaches 6%: Experts
item.description:
Signal: RBI tightening (India). 4 reports from Deccan Chronicle, Business Standard, Free Press Kashmir and 1 more. Related: “RBI may raise repo rate by 50-75 basis points amid rising inflation and global uncertainties”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Real estate: headwind (−2) — Home loans get dearer

Why it matters: A higher repo rate lifts loan rates for homes, vehicles and businesses and pushes up bond yields, though it supports the rupee and lenders' margins at first.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Growth outlook −1, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Fed’s Hammack Reiterates Preference for Small, Incremental Hikes
item.description:
Signal: tighter US monetary policy (US). 14 reports from www.tmgm.com, FXStreet, BigGo Finance and 6 more. Related: “Fed's Hammack reiterates case for slow, steady rate hikes -Bloomberg TV”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Funding costs rise

Why it matters: Higher US rates and yields pull foreign money out of emerging markets, weaken the rupee and push up Indian bond yields.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −3, Rupee −1, Bond market (G-Secs) −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Rising rate hike bets cloud market outlook as inflation breaches RBI's upper band
item.description:
Signal: firmer Indian inflation (India). 30 reports from Moneycontrol.com, finance.biggo.com, Fibre2Fashion and 24 more. Related: “Rising inflation may push up home loan EMIs: Here’s how much more could borrowers pay if RBI hikes repo...”. Turn: earlier readings (14 Nov) pointed the other way.

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Rate cuts pushed back

Why it matters: Faster price growth erodes household budgets and makes RBI rate cuts less likely or hikes more likely, lifting bond yields.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −3, Bond market (G-Secs) −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Treasury prices catch a small bid as stock market weakens and Warsh says AI might 'disappoint'
item.description:
Signal: falling US Treasury yields (US). 3 reports from CNBC, marketscreener.com, Traders Union. Related: “Treasury Yields Fall, Eurozone Bond Yields Seek Direction -- Update”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 16 Nov).

Real estate: mild tailwind (+1) — Funding costs ease

Why it matters: Lower US rates and yields send foreign money back to emerging markets, supporting the rupee, Indian bonds and equities.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows +2, Rupee +1, Bond market (G-Secs) +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
